operation: Every edit was made through Word for Mac's own UI. The UI was driven by an agent session through macOS accessibility (selectText, setValue, pasted plain text, keyboard shortcuts), not by hand as the checklist assumed. No script wrote or rewrote either package; the operator only read the saved XML.
prompts: Each of the two opens raised two Visual Basic for Applications windows: Run-time error '53': File not found: /Library/Application Support/Adobe/MACPDFM/MacPDFM.framework/Versions/A/MacPDFM (an installed Adobe PDF add-in). Each was closed with End; no add-in or security setting was changed.
No repair, recovery or file-format prompt appeared.
deviations: Operator: an agent drove Word's UI through accessibility; the checklist assumed a person.
Step 2: 'Always use this name regardless of how I'm signed in to Office' was turned on for the run and restored afterwards with the original name and initials.
Step 3: 'Remove personal information from this file on save' was not shown in the available Security and Privacy panes; no settings.xml (base or outputs) contains removePersonalInformation.

Steps 5, 6, 14, 15: Word showed classic comments (no Post button, no thread menu). The reply used the Reply button. A first resolve attempt from the context menu did not mark the comment resolved; Review > Comments > Resolve did.
A mistaken shortcut for New Comment opened the Paragraph dialog, which was cancelled.
Before step 7 an imprecise double-click typed into a heading; it was undone with Cmd+Z at once. The saved packages carry no heading revision, and both text projections below match.
Step 9: cut and paste recorded a move on the first attempt; drag and drop was not needed.
Step 16: Word included the following space in the deletion ('any ').
